    rb.count = rb.count + 1;

    let val = get<int>(rb.buffer, rb.head);
    rb.head = (rb.head + 1) % rb.capacity;
    rb.count = rb.count - 1;
    return val;

pub struct DisjointSet {
    Vec<int> parent;
    Vec<int> rank;
}

pub func dsuNew(n: int) -> DisjointSet {
    let mut p: Vec<int> = vecNew<int>();
    let mut r: Vec<int> = vecNew<int>();
    for (let mut i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) {
        p = push<int>(p, i);
        r = push<int>(r, 0);
    }
    return DisjointSet { parent: p, rank: r };
}

pub func dsuFind(dsu: DisjointSet, x: int) -> int {
    let p = get<int>(dsu.parent, x);
    if (p == x) {
        return x;
    }
    let root = dsuFind(dsu, p);
    set<int>(dsu.parent, x, root);
    return root;
}

pub func dsuUnion(dsu: DisjointSet, a: int, b: int) -> int {
    let rootA = dsuFind(dsu, a);
    let rootB = dsuFind(dsu, b);
    if (rootA == rootB) {
        return 0;
    }
    let rankA = get<int>(dsu.rank, rootA);
    let rankB = get<int>(dsu.rank, rootB);
    if (rankA < rankB) {
        set<int>(dsu.parent, rootA, rootB);
    } else {
        if (rankA > rankB) {
            set<int>(dsu.parent, rootB, rootA);
        } else {
            set<int>(dsu.parent, rootB, rootA);
            set<int>(dsu.rank, rootA, rankA + 1);
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

pub func main() -> int {
    let dsu = dsuNew(5);
    dsuUnion(dsu, 0, 1);
    dsuUnion(dsu, 1, 2);
    let root2 = dsuFind(dsu, 2);
    let root0 = dsuFind(dsu, 0);
    outln($"DSU Connected (0 and 2): {root2:str} == {root0:str}");
    return 0;
}

pub struct CacheEntry {
    int key;
    int value;
    int age;
}

pub struct LruCache {
    Vec<CacheEntry> entries;
    int capacity;
    int tick;
}

pub func lruNew(capacity: int) -> LruCache {
    return LruCache { entries: vecNew<CacheEntry>(), capacity: capacity, tick: 0 };
}

pub func lruPut(cache: LruCache, key: int, value: int) {
    cache.tick = cache.tick + 1;
    let n = veclen<CacheEntry>(cache.entries);
    for (let mut i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) {
        let e = get<CacheEntry>(cache.entries, i);
        if (e.key == key) {
            set<CacheEntry>(cache.entries, i, CacheEntry { key: key, value: value, age: cache.tick });
            return;
        }
    }
    if (n >= cache.capacity) {
        let mut oldestIdx = 0;
        let mut oldestAge = get<CacheEntry>(cache.entries, 0).age;
        for (let mut i = 1; i < n; i = i + 1) {
            let curAge = get<CacheEntry>(cache.entries, i).age;
            if (curAge < oldestAge) {
                oldestAge = curAge;
                oldestIdx = i;
            }
        }
        set<CacheEntry>(cache.entries, oldestIdx, CacheEntry { key: key, value: value, age: cache.tick });
    } else {
        cache.entries = push<CacheEntry>(cache.entries, CacheEntry { key: key, value: value, age: cache.tick });
    }
}

pub func lruGet(cache: LruCache, key: int) -> int {
    let n = veclen<CacheEntry>(cache.entries);
    for (let mut i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) {
        let e = get<CacheEntry>(cache.entries, i);
        if (e.key == key) {
            cache.tick = cache.tick + 1;
            set<CacheEntry>(cache.entries, i, CacheEntry { key: key, value: e.value, age: cache.tick });
            return e.value;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

    lruPut(lru, 1, 100);
    lruPut(lru, 2, 200);
    let v1 = lruGet(lru, 1);
    lruPut(lru, 3, 300);
    let evicted2 = lruGet(lru, 2);
    outln($"LRU key 1={v1:str}, key 2={evicted2:str} (evicted)");
    return 0;
}
